title: Our Expert Team
subtitle: Meet our specialized team of dentists providing international standard oral and dental health services.

doc1.title: Prosthodontist & Smile Designer
doc1.bio: Graduated with honors from Antalya University Faculty of Dentistry, Dr. Fırat İskender specializes in Prosthodontics, digital smile architecture, and ceramic restorations.

doc2.title: Smile Design & Aesthetic Specialist
doc2.bio: Dr. Tülay Kaya specializes in porcelain laminate veneers and smile makeovers with over 12 years of clinical expertise.

doc3.title: Orthodontics Specialist
doc3.bio: Dr. Ali Kemal Demir is an internationally certified orthodontist specializing in Invisalign clear aligners and digital jaw alignment.

doc4.title: Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon
doc4.bio: Dr. Ozan Öztürk has over 16 years of surgical excellence in All-on-4 / All-on-6 full arch dental implants and complex bone augmentations.

doc5.title: Restorative & Cosmetic Dentist
doc5.bio: Dr. Julia Rostova is dedicated to composite bonding, teeth whitening, and microscope-assisted aesthetic restorations.

doc6.title: Endodontics & Conservative Specialist
doc6.bio: Dr. Abdullah Yılmaz specializes in microscope-guided root canal therapies and advanced tooth preservation.

doc7.title: Periodontology & Pink Aesthetics
doc7.bio: Dr. Selin Aksoy specializes in laser-assisted gum contouring, gingivoplasty, and periodontal health.

doc8.title: Pediatric Dentist
doc8.bio: Dr. Burak Çelik specializes in pediatric oral health, preventive dentistry, and early orthodontic interventions.
